data.narrative:
Archetype AI is a Series A artificial intelligence and software company founded by Ivan Poupyrev, Brandon Barbello, Leonardo Giusti, Jaime Lien, and Nick Gillian. The company has raised $48M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 9 private companies and 1 public company (Palantir) operating in the AI & Software sector at similar or adjacent funding stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $48M total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A to the next stage, implies a valuation of $96M. Peer-median analysis considers four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Reflection AI ($25.0B, Series A), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B, Series B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B, Series B), and Field AI ($2.0B, Series B). The median valuation across these four peers is $4.4B, with a range spanning $2.0B to $25.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $82M to $5.1B, with a median of $2.3B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around market positioning and near-term revenue trajectory. The stage-progression method anchors the low end, while peer comparables—particularly the large gap between Reflection AI and the Series B cohort—drive upper-bound variance. Key uncertainties include whether Archetype's product-market fit and growth trajectory align with the lower-stage profile of Reflection AI or the more mature Series B valuations.
